QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Within the Giant
QuestInfo.demandSummary: #questorder1#Deal direct damage to the heart of the Giant Monster (#R35112ExdamageRef35132#)
QuestInfo.0:
Now's your chance to get close enough to the Giant Monster attacking the Expedition and stop it. Get inside the Giant Monster and deal direct damage to defeat it and save the Expedition from certain doom.

#r*Damage dealt to the Giant Monster is calculated when you exit #b#m450009402##k.#k
QuestInfo.1:
Now you can get close to the giant monster that's attacking the Expedition. Avoid the giant monster's fierce attacks and get inside to inflict a certain amount of direct damage.

After entering #r#m450009401##b, avoid the giant monster's attacks and enter #r#m450009402##b.
The damage you inflict on the giant monster will be totaled when you leave #r#m450009402##b#k.
QuestInfo.2: You made it to the heart of the Giant Monster and fought it with everything you had. Thanks to your efforts, the Expedition has successfully completed its mission.
